title: Tightened FCFE answer quality and source-unit handling
points: Added analyst guardrails so FCFE answers present retrieved inputs and gaps instead of inventing cost-of-equity, terminal-growth, or per-share fair-value assumptions.
Added retrieved-ticker scope instructions so follow-up answers do not repeat an unsupported company count when fewer tickers were actually retrieved.
Improved unit handling for filing-note extractions so source-page values are not automatically labelled as PKR thousands unless the source supports that basis.
